item.description:
See which provider each agent is.

  • Provider icons: turn on Settings › Appearance › Provider icons and every dot shows its agent's logo (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Grok; a square for other agents), on the strip, the hover card, the Inbox and ⌥⌥. The color still says what the agent is doing, and agents that need you keep their halo.
  • The hover card's marks are now the providers' logos, so a dot on the strip and its row look alike.
  • The Settings preview shows the folded strip beside the hover card.

Fixes agents in cmux blinking in and out.

  • A Claude Code session in cmux no longer appears and disappears every few seconds. cmux can mark a running session as ended and keep it that way; AgentDock now checks whether the session's process is still running before believing it.
  • Claude Code sessions outside cmux show up by themselves again. Claude Code's own installer names its program after its version, and AgentDock didn't recognise it, so those sessions only appeared once the hook reported them.

Fixes a crash, and today's token count.

  • AgentDock no longer quits when Claude Code's hook reports an event. With "Know when Claude Code needs you" turned on, 0.5.3 and 0.5.4 crashed on the first event from any session started afterwards.
  • Today's tokens are counted once. Resumed and forked sessions copy earlier messages into new files, and those were counted again, as was the history a resumed Codex thread carries into its new file. Totals were up to 40% too high.
  • The hover card says how much was re-read from cache. Every request sends the whole conversation again, mostly from the prompt cache, which is why daily totals run into the hundreds of millions.
